cases.combinedChallenge: Combine an associated explicit decision, distinct extra decision, historical contract and superseded original chain through SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit source inputs.

No distinct original, ordering or source binding lost by deduplication
Correct holds for truly invalid input remain

Missing evidence never becomes PASS or actual source defect by assertion

cases.title: Git-native publication, concurrency and history solve the scoped problem without a universal bytes guarantee
cases.baselineClass: Dated private-binding source preparation and synthetic primitive limitations, followed by actual Git-first user steering
cases.combinedChallenge: Two valid branches carry changed source/Work/proposal and historical evidence; a late dependency/ref change races integration. Consume only the reviewed complete tree, preserve third states/history, and keep actual private/native apply separate.
requiredObservables: Git-owned readers consume a complete intended tree, never an unreviewed partial candidate.
Late source/ref/dependency changes preserve third states and independent valid work.
Original meaning and historical contracts survive integration and recovery.
Correct normal consumer progress is retained; more HOLDs alone are not quality improvement.
Any remaining native guarantee is stated at the actual owner/operation boundary with evidence and uncertainty.
Do not confuse a fixture-proven limitation with an observed production failure or a mandatory universal guarantee.
cases.qualityGain: A demonstrated incomplete publication, lost update, history/meaning loss or unjustified global hold is corrected within the actual Git/native owner boundary.
cases.equalQuality: More byte checks, more fixture cases, tree equality alone or absence of current observed failure is not quality improvement.
cases.nativeEffectBoundary: Do not write or reapply the live bindings; no source guard/cache/trust weakening or native budget inheritance.

crossCuttingCIQualities.quality: Declared source/skill member contract and actual consumer must change together.

Actual exact private dependency availability is consumer readiness evidence; do not infer it from synthetic PASS.
Preserve unsuccessful attempts, repairs, source identities and uncertainty instead of reporting final green alone.
